title: The conformally invariant metric on CLE$_4$ III: uniqueness
summary: This paper is the third and final article in a series of papers constructing the canonical conformally invariant metric on the set of loops of the conformal loop ensemble (CLE) with critical parameter $κ=4$. The previous two articles construct, as a subsequential limit of the renormalized graph metric on the loops of CLE$_κ$ as $κ\downarrow 4$, a conformally invariant, local metric on the loops of a CLE$_4$ whose metric ball growth from the domain boundary coincides with the uniform exploration of Werner and Wu.
